intl_finance.document: Evidence of funding for the first year (for example a bank statement or a scholarship or financial aid award letter) uploaded to the OISS New Student Survey; Yale College students do not complete a financial certification form.

deadlines.label: OISS New Student Survey and funding documents (OISS emails the survey link 3 to 5 days after you accept the offer, starting mid to late March)
deadlines.note: OISS says there is no hard OISS deadline, but the I-20 is issued only after the survey and funding documents arrive, and then typically takes 7 to 10 business days.

intl_finance.notes: Financial aid is separate and is not the I-20 proof of funds: international Early Action aid documents are due 2026-12-01 and Regular Decision aid documents on February 15 (source 5). The F-1 visa page https://oiss.yale.edu/getting-started/new-students/applying-for-your-us-visa/applying-for-the-f-1-student-visa gives a bank statement or an award letter as examples of funding evidence to bring to the visa interview.

notes: The QuestBridge application answers only the two Short answers; the Short takes and the Yale essay are for Common App or Coalition applicants (source 1). The 'Why Yale' question was dropped this cycle (source 2). The Short takes limit is stated as no more than 200 characters (approximately 35 words); only the character limit is recorded. Source 4 confirms there is no hard OISS deadline and that Yale College students upload funding evidence to the New Student Survey. OISS gives no fixed date for funding documents. The aid deadlines in the intl_finance notes were read on the page for the 2027-28 academic year.
